title: written text after <vox> fillers are hidden
description: A <vox> filler is spoken but never shown. Hiding it must leave the punctuation a writer would have used: no stray comma where the filler was, a kept comma that the sentence needs, and a capital letter where the filler started a sentence. Cases come from real assistant replies. `streaming` cases are a reply still arriving; the Host never renders those, so its runner skips them. Every client runs all of them: server/lib/voice_markup.py, static/lib/voice-markup.js, desktop-rs/core/src/text.rs, and iOS MarkdownParser.cleanVoiceMarkup.

cases.name: greeting filler and sentence-start filler
cases.input: <vox>hey</vox>, Duster here. <vox>so</vox>, what are we getting into today?
cases.expect: Duster here. What are we getting into today?

cases.name: filler after a full stop leaves no comma behind
cases.input: Clarp it is. <vox>okay so</vox>, I'll go through the code.
cases.expect: Clarp it is. I'll go through the code.

cases.name: comma before a filler is the sentence's comma
cases.input: is it a specific screen, <vox>like</vox> the chat scrolling, or the car mode?
cases.expect: is it a specific screen, the chat scrolling, or the car mode?

cases.name: identifiers keep their case
cases.input: <vox>so</vox>, iOS builds are green. <vox>um</vox> `npm test` passes.
cases.expect: iOS builds are green. `npm test` passes.

cases.name: capitalises a word glued to an em dash
capitalises a word followed by inline HTML
filler between two commas keeps one
cases.input: He has a telephone dial on his chest, <vox>you know</vox>, and little signals.
cases.expect: He has a telephone dial on his chest, and little signals.

cases.name: filler between commas after an interjection
cases.input: Ah, <vox>you know</vox>, the browser was only hot-reloading.
cases.expect: Ah, the browser was only hot-reloading.

cases.name: filler between words
cases.input: They got killed <vox>uh</vox> so I have no completion times.
cases.expect: They got killed so I have no completion times.

cases.name: comma after a mid-sentence filler is dropped
cases.input: And <vox>um</vox>, that press-to-skip idea is solid.
cases.expect: And that press-to-skip idea is solid.

cases.name: like with a trailing comma
cases.input: Just say A or B, or <vox>like</vox>, paste that JSON.
cases.expect: Just say A or B, or paste that JSON.

cases.name: leading comma written inside the filler is kept
cases.input: Great<vox>, so</vox> I'll hand it to a sub-agent.
cases.expect: Great, I'll hand it to a sub-agent.

cases.name: comma then filler then full stop
cases.input: That passed the human check, <vox>nice</vox>. A pop-up follows.
cases.expect: That passed the human check. A pop-up follows.

cases.name: whole hidden sentence
cases.input: All set. <vox>Ja, nettopp.</vox> Det knytter alt sammen.
cases.expect: All set. Det knytter alt sammen.

cases.name: whole hidden sentence ending in an ellipsis
cases.input: Everything is in stock. <vox>One catch, though...</vox> the loose-leaf tea is gone.
cases.expect: Everything is in stock. The loose-leaf tea is gone.

cases.name: filler with an exclamation opening the reply
em dash then filler then comma
em dash then filler then word
cases.input: Both commits are on main — <vox>uh</vox> one thing worth knowing.
cases.expect: Both commits are on main — one thing worth knowing.

cases.name: filler glued to an em dash at the start
colon before a filler
cases.input: Here's the thing: <vox>um</vox>, the cache is stale.
cases.expect: Here's the thing: the cache is stale.

cases.name: several fillers in a row at the start
several fillers in a row mid-sentence
emotion tag glued to the next word, then a filler
emotion tag before a blank line
filler after a blank line
cases.input:
That was the earlier test.

<vox>So</vox>, my recommendation is simple.
cases.expect:
That was the earlier test.

My recommendation is simple.

cases.name: filler at the end of a line
filler opening a list item
cases.input:
Steps:
- <vox>so</vox>, the first item
- second item
cases.expect:
Steps:
- The first item
- second item

cases.name: text without fillers is untouched
cases.input: Commas, stay put; spacing too — fine.
cases.expect: Commas, stay put; spacing too — fine.

cases.name: streaming: finished filler and an unfinished tag
